"""External T06 bounded native11 + existing developer conversion controller."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(r"<WORKSPACE>")
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
PS51 = Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe"
PS7 = Path(r"<USERPROFILE>\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe")
CALIBRE = Path(r"<USERPROFILE>\Apps\Calibre915\Calibre Portable\Calibre\ebook-convert.exe")

def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

conversion = load("t06_native_controller_conversion", ROOT / "engine/winbooksplit_conversion.py")

def write(path, record):
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(record, stream, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")

def run(identifier, argv, timeout):
    jobs = []
    def factory(arguments, *, cwd, env):
        process = conversion._default_process_factory(arguments, cwd=cwd, env=env)
        jobs.append(process)
        return process
    before_environment = dict(os.environ)
    started = datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat()
    try:
        record = conversion._run_converter([str(value) for value in argv], cwd=str(ROOT),
            env=dict(os.environ), timeout_seconds=timeout, process_factory=factory)
        result = {"id": identifier, "started_utc": started,
            "finished_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "command": [str(value) for value in argv], "cwd": str(ROOT),
            "timeout_seconds": timeout, "environment_override_keys": [],
            "parent_environment_unchanged": before_environment == dict(os.environ),
            "job_assigned_before_resume": len(jobs) == 1 and jobs[0].assigned_before_resume,
            "descendants_stopped": len(jobs) == 1 and jobs[0]._tree_stopped,
            "process": record}
    except Exception as error:
        result = {"id": identifier, "started_utc": started,
            "finished_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
            "command": [str(value) for value in argv], "cwd": str(ROOT),
            "timeout_seconds": timeout, "environment_override_keys": [],
            "parent_environment_unchanged": before_environment == dict(os.environ),
            "error": str(error), "tree_stopped": getattr(error, "tree_stopped", None),
            "process": dict(getattr(error, "conversion", {}) or {})}
    write(WORK / (identifier + "-process.json"), result)
    if result.get("process", {}).get("exit_code") != 0 or result.get("error"):
        raise RuntimeError(identifier + " did not complete successfully; preserve its process receipt")
    if not result["job_assigned_before_resume"] or not result["descendants_stopped"]:
        raise RuntimeError(identifier + " supervision incomplete")
    print(identifier + " completed with bounded native supervision", flush=True)

def main():
    if not sys.flags.isolated or not sys.dont_write_bytecode:
        raise RuntimeError("Existing explicit developer Python -I -B required for controller only")
    mode = sys.argv[1]
    if mode == "native":
        for name, shell in (("ps51", PS51), ("ps7", PS7)):
            run("native11-" + name, [shell, "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "RemoteSigned",
                "-File", WORK / "actual-diagnostics.ps1", "-ApplicationRoot", ROOT,
                "-OutputPath", WORK / ("native11-" + name + ".json")], 180)
    elif mode == "conversion":
        run("conversion", [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", ROOT / "tests/conversion/characterize_conversion.py",
            "--report", WORK / "conversion.json", "--shell-path", PS51, "--shell-path", PS7,
            "--calibre-path", CALIBRE], 600)
    elif mode == "smoke":
        run("conversion-smoke", [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", WORK / "run-ebook-smoke.py"], 600)
    elif mode == "bat-repro":
        run("bat-cache-reproduction", [sys.executable, "-I", "-B", WORK / "reproduce-bat-cache.py"], 180)
    elif mode == "manager-control":
        run("manager-cache-control", [PS51, "-NoProfile", "-NonInteractive", "-ExecutionPolicy", "RemoteSigned",

"""Narrow T06 authored ebook regression using unchanged maintained oracles."""
from datetime import datetime, timezone
from hashlib import sha256
import importlib.util
import json
import os
from pathlib import Path
import sys

ROOT = Path(r"<WORKSPACE>")
WORK = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
CASES = WORK / "ebook-smoke"
FIXTURES = WORK.parent / "fixtures"
PS51 = Path(os.environ["SystemRoot"]) / "System32/WindowsPowerShell/v1.0/powershell.exe"
PS7 = Path(r"<USERPROFILE>\.cache\codex-runtimes\codex-primary-runtime\dependencies\native\powershell\pwsh.exe")
CALIBRE = Path(r"<USERPROFILE>\Apps\Calibre915\Calibre Portable\Calibre\ebook-convert.exe")

def load(name, path):
    spec = importlib.util.spec_from_file_location(name, path)
    module = importlib.util.module_from_spec(spec)
    sys.modules[name] = module
    spec.loader.exec_module(module)
    return module

existing = load("t06_maintained_conversion", ROOT / "tests/conversion/characterize_conversion.py")
require = existing.require

def write(path, data):
    with path.open("x", encoding="utf-8", newline="\n") as stream:
        json.dump(data, stream, ensure_ascii=True, indent=2)
        stream.write("\n")

def main():
    sys.stdout.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
    sys.stderr.reconfigure(encoding="utf-8", errors="backslashreplace")
    require(os.name == "nt" and sys.flags.isolated and sys.dont_write_bytecode, "Actual existing Windows developer Python -I -B required")
    before = existing.runner.source_manifest()
    require(sha256(CALIBRE.read_bytes()).hexdigest() == existing.fixtures.EXPECTED_CALIBRE_SHA256, "Existing approved Calibre bytes differ")
    CASES.mkdir()
    catalog = json.loads((FIXTURES / "native-fixtures.json").read_text(encoding="utf-8"))
    inputs = {str(FIXTURES / row["name"]): row["sha256"] for row in catalog["files"].values()}
    require(inputs == {path: existing.history.file_digest(Path(path)) for path in inputs}, "Frozen authored fixture bytes differ")
    sources = {fmt: FIXTURES / catalog["files"][fmt]["name"] for fmt in ("epub", "azw3")}
    references = {fmt: existing.reference_pdf(source, CASES / (fmt + ".pdf"), CALIBRE, CASES) for fmt, source in sources.items()}
    engine = existing.load("t06_existing_ebook_engine", ROOT / "engine/winbooksplit_engine.py")
    probe = CASES / "Host.ps1"
    probe.write_text("[Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)\n"
        "$total=0; $checked=@('WinBookSplit.ps1','engine/WinBookSplit.Paths.ps1','engine/WinBookSplit.Diagnostics.ps1')\n"
        "foreach($name in $checked){$tokens=$null;$errors=$null;[Management.Automation.Language.Parser]::ParseFile((Join-Path $env:WBS_PATHS_ROOT $name),[ref]$tokens,[ref]$errors)|Out-Null;$total+=$errors.Count}\n"
        "$policies=@(Get-ExecutionPolicy -List|Where-Object {$_.Scope -ne 'Process'}|ForEach-Object {[pscustomobject]@{scope=$_.Scope.ToString();policy=$_.ExecutionPolicy.ToString()}})\n"
        "[pscustomobject]@{host_major=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.Major;host_version=$PSVersionTable.PSVersion.ToString();syntax_checked=$checked;syntax_error_count=$total;stored_policies=$policies}|ConvertTo-Json -Depth 6 -Compress\n", encoding="utf-8")
    hosts = [existing.paths.host_observation(shell, CASES, probe) for shell in (PS51, PS7)]
    require({host["id"] for host in hosts} == {"PS51", "PS7"}, "Both actual shell hosts required")
    wrapper = CASES / "Invoke.ps1"
    wrapper.write_text("[Console]::OutputEncoding=New-Object Text.UTF8Encoding($false)\n"
        "$keep=$env:WBS_CONVERSION_KEEP -eq '1'\n"
        "& $env:WBS_CONVERSION_SCRIPT -InputFile $env:WBS_CONVERSION_INPUT -OutputDirectory $env:WBS_CONVERSION_BASE -CalibrePath $env:WBS_CONVERSION_CALIBRE -KeepConvertedPdf:$keep\n"
        "exit $LASTEXITCODE\n", encoding="utf-8")
    direct, real = [], []
    counter = 0
    def owned(fmt):
        nonlocal counter
        counter += 1
        directory = CASES / ("case" + str(counter))
        directory.mkdir()
        source = directory / ("Book [1] O'Neil & (章节) %!." + fmt)
        source.write_bytes(sources[fmt].read_bytes())
        base = CASES / ("output" + str(counter))
        base.mkdir()
        return source, base, directory
    for fmt in ("epub", "azw3"):
        source, base, directory = owned(fmt)
        row = existing.direct_case(fmt, engine, CASES, source, base, CALIBRE, references[fmt], inputs)
        direct.append(row)
        write(CASES / ("direct-" + fmt + ".json"), row)
    for host in hosts:
        for fmt in ("epub", "azw3"):
            for keep in (False, True):
                source, base, directory = owned(fmt)
                identifier = host["id"] + "-" + fmt + ("-keep" if keep else "-default")
                row = existing.launcher_case(identifier, Path(host["shell_executable"]), source, base, directory,
                    wrapper, CALIBRE, references[fmt], inputs, keep=keep)
                real.append(row)
                write(CASES / (identifier + ".json"), row)
    for host in hosts:
        after = existing.paths.host_observation(Path(host["shell_executable"]), CASES, probe)
        require(after["stored_policies"] == host["stored_policies"], "Stored shell policy changed")
        host["policies_after"] = after["stored_policies"]
    require(inputs == {path: existing.history.file_digest(Path(path)) for path in inputs}, "An authored original/input/neighbor changed")
    require(before == existing.runner.source_manifest(), "Source changed during authored smoke")
    require(len(direct) == 2 and len(real) == 8 and all(row["passed"] for row in [*direct, *real]), "Incomplete actual authored smoke")
    report = {"schema_version": 1, "task": "T06", "success": True,
        "kind": "SHORT_AUTHORED_EPUB_AZW3_EXPLICIT_DEVELOPER_REGRESSION",
        "meaning": "Eight actual shell format/default/keep ebook runs plus two direct captured-reader controls reuse unchanged maintained functions. These developer cases use a clean child PATH containing developer Python and explicit approved Calibre; they do not prove automatic native/Store discovery.",
        "observed_utc": datetime.now(timezone.utc).isoformat(),
        "source_unchanged": True, "tested_path_sha256": before,
        "calibre": {"path": str(CALIBRE), "version": existing.fixtures.EXPECTED_CALIBRE_VERSION,
            "sha256": sha256(CALIBRE.read_bytes()).hexdigest()},
        "host_cases": hosts, "fixture_catalog": catalog, "reference_conversions": references,
        "direct_api_cases": direct, "real_cases": real, "input_sha256": inputs,
        "input_and_neighbor_unchanged": True, "machine_settings_unchanged": True,
        "retained_reference_and_fixture_work": str(CASES),
        "environment": {"python": sys.version, "python_executable": sys.executable, "pypdf": existing.history.pypdf.__version__},
        "not_run": ["Full conversion suite pass", "BAT missing-converter cache control", "Owner Store/native Windows10", "Physical Explorer", "GUI"]}
    write(WORK / "conversion-smoke.json", report)
    print("Narrow authored EPUB/AZW3 smoke passed: 8 actual PS runs, 2 direct controls", flush=True)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
